title: Don't show "Network disconnected" notification after the disconnect button in the plasma-nm widget is clicked
line: Disconnecting a network or VPN yourself no longer pops up a "Connection deactivated" notification.
explanation: The kded notifier listened to ActiveConnection::stateChanged, which carries no reason, so every Deactivated state produced a "Connection deactivated" notification, including the one caused by the user pressing Disconnect. For VPNs the reason was known but only used to swap the warning icon for an info icon. NetworkManager reports USER_DISCONNECTED as the active connection's state reason when the device was disconnected on user request. The notifier now listens to stateChangedReason and returns early for UserDisconnected (and for VPN UserDisconnectedReason); natural disconnects still notify.

commits.message:
kded: don't notify when the user disconnects a connection

Disconnecting a network or VPN from the applet showed a "Connection
deactivated" notification, telling the user about something they just
did. Use the reason NetworkManager gives and skip user disconnects.

BUG: 409774

media.caption: Master: Disconnect on Wired 1 in the Networks popup shows "Connection 'Wired 1' deactivated."
Master: a VPN disconnected by the user shows "VPN connection 'Office VPN' deactivated."

review.text: Correct root-cause fix: it uses networkmanager-qt's stateChangedReason and skips UserDisconnected, which NM reports for Device.Disconnect and 'nmcli connection down', while carrier loss and other reasons still notify. The VPN branch does the same, and the dead 'user disconnected' text and icon special cases are removed. The change is small and in the right place, and the mock-NM before/after and regression checks cover it.
